# Poe2OsdTtlBuilder

[API index](../index.md)

The TTL-draw builder returned by [`Poe2OsdAccessor::WithTtl`]. Carries the requested TTL (ms) and
exposes the SAME draw method set as [`Poe2OsdAccessor`]; each draw enqueues into the manager's
TTL store (`ExpiresAt = now + ttl`) instead of the per-frame buffer. An OPAQUE handle: `ttl_ms`
is deliberately PRIVATE (not a script member), so the generated `interface Poe2OsdTtlBuilder`
carries only the draw methods. At runtime the methods are dispatched to
`PoebaneScriptMemberHost`, resolving the TTL from the generated owned handle.
